texts.text_1: Sometimes, it is crucial for logistical requests to arrive as a single package
texts.text_4: Otherwise, other packages could arrive inbetween
texts.text_5: When this is the case, redirect packages to an inventory
texts.text_6: Attach a re-packager, and power it with redstone
texts.text_7: Once all fragments arrived, they will be exported as a new package
texts.text_8: Now, requested items arrive together and in a predictable order

args.text: Sometimes, it is crucial for logistical requests to arrive as a single package
Otherwise, other packages could arrive inbetween
When this is the case, redirect packages to an inventory
Attach a re-packager, and power it with redstone
Once all fragments arrived, they will be exported as a new package
Now, requested items arrive together and in a predictable order
